title: Threw it out, smelled bad
text: Threw it out, smelled bad. I threw it out. Can't tolerate the chemical stink of it. It's worse than a mildewy smell is. I bought the lavender scented but the chemicals overpowered the lavender.

product_metadata.title: WM Barr Lavender Vanilla Moisture Absorber Dehumidifier (Set of 2)
features: Diseñado para colgar en armarios y pequeños espacios cerrados para proteger telas y artículos de daño por humedad
Dura aproximadamente 60 días y absorbe hasta un cuarto de litro de exceso de humedad del aire
Ideal para reducir los alergenos, eliminando los olores y absorbiendo la humedad en espacios pequeños y cerrados
No se utilizan productos químicos ásperos
Reduce el crecimiento de moho y moho
description: The DampRid 2 Pack Refillable Moisture Absorber Cups are your solution for continuous cleaner, fresher air. This musty odor eliminator works by attracting and trapping excess moisture to maintain an optimal humidity level. Works wonders as a closet deodorizer, freshener, or odor neutralizer wherever moisture in an issue. Use this multipack one at a time for long-lasting freshness or spread them out between the bathroom, laundry room, kitchen, home office, basement, garage, stored boat, or RV. To use this convenient odor absorber, simply open the bag of crystals, pour into the top tray of the canister and close lid. When the odor absorbing crystals have dissolved, dispose of the water by pouring into a toilet, then refill with new crystals. These air deodorizer odor eliminator cups are available in Fragrance Free, Fresh Scent, Lavender Vanilla, and Pure Linen. Keep out of reach of children. Read and follow all label directions.
